name: Date Math
description: Exact date and time math for AI agents: business days, public holidays for 207 countries, time zones, DST, SLA deadlines, cron and RRULE schedules, and stock-market calendars. 25 free calls a day, then $0.001 per call via x402.
author: JowenDelaPena

tools.name: date_diff
tools.title: Date difference
tools.description: How many days, weeks, months or business days between two dates or datetimes: calendar (Y/M/D), totals, and business days (weekdays in [from, to) minus holidays; pass country to exclude its public holidays). Use for age, tenure, countdowns, notice periods and working days until a deadline. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or ISO 8601 datetime with Z or offset

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or ISO 8601 datetime with Z or offset

holidays.description: Extra dates excluded from business-day counts (rest days from workdays are always excluded)

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (207 countries); its public holidays (2000–2050) are excluded from business days

workdays.description: Working days of the week, 0 = Sunday. Default [1,2,3,4,5] (Mon–Fri); e.g. [0,1,2,3,4] for Sun–Thu or [1,2,3,4,5,6] for Mon–Sat

inputSchema.description: business_days counts working days (default Mon–Fri, see workdays) in [from, to) minus holidays; only for date inputs.

business_days.description: Weekdays in [from, to) minus holidays (date inputs only)

Month-end clamping; business days skip weekends, given holidays, and the public holidays of an optional country. Use for due dates, deadlines, delivery estimates, expiry and "N working days from today". First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or ISO 8601 datetime with Z or offset

business_days.description: Applied after calendar units; skips rest days (see workdays) and holidays

holidays.description: Extra dates excluded from business-day counts (rest days from workdays are always excluded)

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (207 countries); its public holidays (2000–2050) are excluded from business days

inputSchema.description: Negative values subtract. Months clamp to month end (Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28/29). Time units require a datetime input.

tools.name: date_range
tools.title: Reporting period to exact dates
tools.description: Turn a reporting period into exact start and end dates and times in a time zone: "last month", "this quarter", "YTD", "MTD", "last 7 days", "next 2 weeks", "2026-Q3", "2026-W14". Optional comparison period (previous period, or same period last year), fiscal years starting in any month, and Monday, Sunday or Saturday week starts. Spaces work too ("last 7 days"). last_N_days = N complete days before today; last_N_months = N complete calendar months before this one. tools.name: business_day_schedule
tools.title: Business-day job schedule
tools.description: Schedules that understand business days and public holidays, which cron cannot express: "3rd business day of the month at 09:00", "last business day", "every Monday, or the next business day if it is a holiday", "the 25th, modified following", or any cron expression with a holiday rule. Returns the next run times and whether the job should run on a given date (today by default). Country holidays, custom holidays and workweeks, DST-aware. Use for payroll, billing, reporting and batch jobs. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

rule.description: nth_business_day needs n; day_of_month needs day; weekly needs weekdays; cron needs expression

n.description: nth_business_day: 1 = first business day of the month, 3 = third; -1 = last, -2 = second to last. Not 0

day.description: day_of_month: 1–31 (31 means the last day in shorter months) or "last"

weekdays.description: weekly: weekday numbers, 0 = Sunday, e.g. [1] for every Monday

expression.description: cron: 5 or 6 field cron expression, e.g. "0 9 25 * *". At most 96 runs a day

time.description: Local run time HH:MM for nth_business_day, day_of_month and weekly (cron uses its own times)

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York (default UTC)

adjust.description: When a scheduled date is a weekend or holiday: move to the next/previous business day; modified_following = next unless that crosses into the next month, then previous; nearest (ties go earlier); skip the run; or none. Not used by nth_business_day

months.description: Only these months, e.g. [1,4,7,10] for quarterly

from.description: Runs at or after this time: YYYY-MM-DD (local midnight), local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or ISO 8601 with offset. Default: now

count.description: How many runs to return (searches up to 10 years ahead)

holidays.description: Extra dates excluded from business-day counts (rest days from workdays are always excluded)

workdays.description: Working days of the week, 0 = Sunday. Default [1,2,3,4,5] (Mon–Fri); e.g. [0,1,2,3,4] for Sun–Thu or [1,2,3,4,5,6] for Mon–Sat

datetime.description: Local run time, ISO 8601 with offset

scheduled_date.description: The date the rule produced before the weekend/holiday adjustment

reason.description: Why the scheduled date was moved: weekend, or holiday: <name>
weekend, holiday: <name>, or null on a business day

runs.description: Whether the job runs on this date

scheduled_run_moved_to.description: When a run was scheduled on this date but moved: its new date, or "skipped"
